Priya Desai: Flagging an issue: customer SolsticeLabs received invoice INV-SOL-2026-07 showing platform fee twice. Low severity but need a clean audit trail before renewal.

Priya Desai: ```INV-SOL-2026-07
- Onprem license (12mo)      $95,000
- Platform fee (annual)      $22,500
- Platform fee (annual)      $22,500  <- duplicate
- Support (Silver)            $9,750
TOTAL                         $149,750
```

Liam O'Connor: Thanks. Do we have prior credits or a manual reversal? @rosa any history?

Rosa Martinez: Checking AR notes. We applied a migration credit (2025-10-15) for $22,500. The billing engine appears to have re-added the platform fee when rolling the new annual invoice, leaving both the reversal on ledger and a fresh charge visible.

Noah Kim: Quick options: credit memo applied forward, corrected reissued invoice, or refund. Finance prefers credit memo to avoid cash flow impact.

Priya Desai: Legal preference? Need wording that references the earlier reversal.

Rosa Martinez: Legal reviewed — they want the memo to state: "Accounting duplicate adjustment referencing reversal dated 2025-10-15." Also include original invoice and payment references.

Liam O'Connor: Customer paid via ACH on 2026-04-01. I pinged Solstice billing to ask if they'd accept the credit on next term or want refund.

Liam O'Connor: Customer replied: "Apply credit to next year's invoice and email the credit memo. Thanks."

Priya Desai: Great. Rosa, please draft CM-SOL-190999 and attach to a billing ticket. @billing-bot create ticket and set to manual review.

Rosa Martinez: Drafting now. Will include line: "Duplicate accounting adjustment; credit applied to next renewal per customer instruction. Original reversal 2025-10-15."

billing-bot: Created ticket FIN-BILL-2026-190999. Upload the memo when ready. Status: awaiting AR posting. :white_check_mark:

Noah Kim: After AR posts, RevOps needs to adjust recognition schedule. @liam please confirm posting date so RevOps can update forecast.

Liam O'Connor: Will confirm when AR marks it posted.

Rosa Martinez: Uploaded memo to ticket and notified AR.

billing-bot: Ticket updated: FIN-BILL-2026-190999 -> status changed to posted on 2026-04-15.

Priya Desai: Closing the loop 64f Customer acknowledged receipt of memo. Thanks team.
